C25 is the closest because it concerns voluntary plans, interagency consultation, and committees or working groups, but it delegates statutory authority over resource controls rather than establishing a named interdepartmental committee with a chairman, agency-head membership, enumerated promotional and clearinghouse duties, liaison officers, and an implementation mandate. These are broad administrative similarities, not distinctive shared drafting or substantially parallel machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Committee shall perform the following functions and duties","parent_excerpt":"Each agency shall establish such committees and other working groups as may be appropriate to consult with and obtain the advice of other agencies.","explanation":"C25 contains committee-based interagency consultation, but not the child's centralized committee structure or its sequence of promotional, assistance, clearinghouse, recommendation, and liaison provisions."},{"child_excerpt":"the voluntary Payroll Savings Plan","parent_excerpt":"encouraging the making of voluntary agreements or plans","explanation":"C25 shares the concepts of voluntariness and plans, but the language is generic and the plans serve materially different legal and administrative functions."},{"child_excerpt":"Each of the departments, establishments, and agencies in the executive branch of the Government shall institute and set in operation","parent_excerpt":"All Federal agencies coming within the purview of the Federal Register Act are requested to cooperate","explanation":"C24 has a general government-wide cooperation direction, but lacks the child's committee-led implementation machinery."}]}
